params:
  cellset: "ob334"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
source(file.path(rprojroot::find_root("CLAUDE.md"), "R/utils.R"))
library(clustree)
out_dir <- cellset_dir(params$cellset)
set.seed(SEED)
```

## Data
```{r load}
obj <- load_cellset(params$cellset)
obj
table(obj$cellset_label, obj$timepoint)
stopifnot(ncol(obj) == c(ob334 = 334, obfin = 6083)[[params$cellset]])
```

## HVG selection and PCA
```{r hvg-pca}
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
obj <- embed_features(obj)
dims <- 1:choose_dims(obj)
ElbowPlot(obj, ndims = N_PCS) + geom_vline(xintercept = max(dims), linetype = 2) +
  ggtitle(sprintf("Using %d PCs", max(dims)))
```

## Resolution sweep
```{r sweep, fig.height=8}
obj <- cluster_sweep(obj, dims, prefix = "hvg")
summ <- sweep_summary(obj, "hvg")
knitr::kable(summ)
clustree(obj, prefix = "hvg_")
res <- pick_resolution(summ)
obj$hvg_cluster <- obj[[paste0("hvg_", res)]][, 1]
Idents(obj) <- "hvg_cluster"
cat("Chosen resolution:", res, "-> K =", nlevels(obj$hvg_cluster), "\n")
table(obj$hvg_cluster)
```

## UMAP
```{r umap, fig.width=12}
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = dims, seed.use = SEED, verbose = FALSE)
DimPlot(obj, label = TRUE) + DimPlot(obj, group.by = "timepoint") +
  DimPlot(obj, group.by = "cellset_label") + plot_layout(ncol = 3) & theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
FeaturePlot(obj, intersect(OB_MARKERS, rownames(obj)), ncol = 5) & NoAxes()
```

## Markers
```{r markers}
markers <- FindAllMarkers(obj, only.pos = TRUE, logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.1, verbose = FALSE)
markers$specificity <- markers$pct.1 - markers$pct.2
top <- markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 8)
knitr::kable(top[, c("cluster", "gene", "avg_log2FC", "pct.1", "pct.2", "p_val_adj")], digits = 3)
```

## Sensitivity to the number of HVGs
```{r sensitivity}
sens <- sapply(c(1000, 3000), function(n) {
  o <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, nfeatures = n, verbose = FALSE)
  o <- embed_features(o)
  o <- FindNeighbors(o, dims = dims, k.param = k_for(ncol(o)), verbose = FALSE)
  o <- FindClusters(o, resolution = res, random.seed = SEED, verbose = FALSE)
  c(K = nlevels(Idents(o)), ARI_vs_2000 = safe_ari(Idents(o), obj$hvg_cluster))
})
colnames(sens) <- c("1000 HVGs", "3000 HVGs")
knitr::kable(t(sens), digits = 3)
```

## Reproducibility check
```{r repro}
o <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = res, random.seed = SEED, verbose = FALSE)
stopifnot(safe_ari(Idents(o), obj$hvg_cluster) == 1)
cat("Same-seed rerun ARI = 1\n")
```

```{r save}
obj@misc$hvg_dims <- dims
obj@misc$hvg_res  <- res
obj@misc$hvg_features <- VariableFeatures(obj)
obj[["pca_hvg"]] <- obj[["pca"]]; obj[["umap_hvg"]] <- obj[["umap"]]
saveRDS(obj, file.path(out_dir, "ob_seurat.rds"))
write.csv(markers, file.path(out_dir, "markers_seurat.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
